source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: If this model is **destroyed** during the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) before its unit is **selected to fight**, roll a D6 before removing it. On 2+, leave it on the battlefield until it fights or the phase ends, whichever happens first.

detail.timing: model destroyed during Fight phase before its unit selected to fight
detail.removeWhen: model has fought or Fight phase ends, whichever first
